text:
The deed creates a fee simple subject to an executory limitation in the friend, with a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25; because the interest is contingent and the class is open, the Rule Against Perpetuities applies. The sister’s children are lives in being, and any child born during the sister’s lifetime will reach 25, if at all, within 21 years of the sister’s death, so the class is valid as to all such children. Title is therefore in the friend, the son, the daughter, and any additional children of the sister born during her lifetime.

CONFIDENCE: 95
